description: This file defines an abstract class 'Message' implementing the PSR-7 MessageInterface for the Slim Framework. It manages HTTP message elements like protocol version, headers, and body, providing methods to get and set these properties, implementing immutability patterns.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the PSR-7 MessageInterface, providing methods for managing HTTP message components like protocol version, headers, and body, with support for immutability.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol version used in the message.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version, validating allowed versions.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as an array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a specific header exists.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a header's value as an array.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Retrieves a header's value as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified header set to a given value.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an added header.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified body.
